description: This shell script is a test script that orchestrates a series of Git repository operations to verify packfile management, including packing objects, checking packfile existence, and ensuring objects are in the correct packfiles.

methods.name: test_commit
methods.description: Adds a commit with a specified message, used to create test data in the Git repository.

methods.name: test_expect_success
methods.description: Defines a test case that is expected to succeed, taking a description and a shell code block.

methods.name: test-tool find-pack
methods.description: Finds the packfile associated with a given object or reference.

methods.name: test-tool find-pack --check-count
methods.description: Checks the number of packfiles containing a specific object or reference.

methods.name: test-tool find-pack -c
methods.description: Shortcut for --check-count, specifying the expected number of packfiles containing the object.

methods.name: test-tool find-pack HEAD
methods.description: Finds the packfile associated with the current HEAD commit.

methods.name: test-tool find-pack HEAD^{tree}
methods.description: Finds the packfile containing the tree object of HEAD.

methods.name: test-tool find-pack HEAD:filename
methods.description: Finds the packfile containing the specific file in the current HEAD.

methods.name: test-tool find-pack --check-count 1 HEAD
methods.description: Verifies that exactly one packfile contains HEAD.

methods.name: git repack
methods.description: Repackages all objects into a single packfile.

methods.name: git pack-objects
methods.description: Creates new packfiles from objects in the repository.

methods.name: test_done
methods.description: Marks the completion of the test script.
